title: ZOIF: Zeroth-Order Influence Function Estimation for LLM Data Selection Using Only Forward Passes
abstract: arXiv:2610.15336v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Influence functions enable principled data selection for large language models (e.g., identifying influential training samples for model editing, debugging, or efficient fine-tuning). However, scaling IFs to LLMs is hindered by the intractability of billion-scale Hessian matrices and the prohibitive memory overhead of backpropagation (BP). While many classical IF approximations reduce Hessian complexity, they still rely on BP for gradient computation, requiring massive storage for intermediate activations that impedes practical data selection at scale. To address this, we propose ZOIF, a zeroth-order framework for influence estimation that operates entirely via forward passes, enabling memory-efficient data selection under resource constraints. ZOIF decomposes influence estimation into three BP-free stages: (1) approximating the average proxy gradient via zeroth-order estimation; (2) reformulating and solving the inverse Hessian-vector

translated_title: ZOIF：仅通过前向传播实现大语言模型数据选择的零阶影响函数估计
translated_abstract: 影响函数为大语言模型提供了有原则的数据选择方法（例如，识别对模型编辑、调试或高效微调最具影响的训练样本）。然而，将影响函数扩展到大语言模型面临两大障碍：十亿规模级别的Hessian矩阵难以处理，以及反向传播（BP）带来的过高内存开销。虽然许多经典的影响函数近似方法降低了Hessian矩阵的计算复杂度，但它们仍然依赖反向传播来计算梯度，需要大量存储中间激活值，这阻碍了大规模场景下的实际数据选择。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了ZOIF，一个完全通过前向传播运行的零阶影响估计框架，能够在资源受限的条件下实现内存高效的数据选择。ZOIF将影响估计分解为三个无需反向传播的阶段：(1) 通过零阶估计近似平均代理梯度；(2) 重新表述并求解逆Hessian-向量乘积问题……
tldr: 提出ZOIF框架，通过零阶估计完全基于前向传播进行影响函数估计，无需反向传播和中间激活值存储，实现了资源受限条件下大语言模型的内存高效数据选择。
en_tdlr: ZOIF is a zeroth-order influence function estimation framework that operates entirely via forward passes, eliminating the need for backpropagation and intermediate activation storage, thus enabling memory-efficient data selection for LLMs under resource constraints.
